Saw Kubz Scouts play this on YT and it got me interested. The whole storytelling is really immersing and tense, the game is really educational, I like the way it showcases emotional manipulation and guilt-tripping from toxic relationships (and yes, even with "friends" too. The guilt-tripping and victim blaming part of the game really triggered me, as I have the same experiences with those kinds of "friends" irl). My favorite part of the game is probably the packaging section, it made me feel a bit pressured but it's still's fun nonetheless (I know, not the main focus of the game lol). The weird commentary and ass compliments would probably swoon me if it was from somebody I like/somebody I've been intimate with, but with people like Radek? People you don't view that way and/or not that close with? hell nah, those guys suck.

10/10 I might play more just to see the other endings.

Первое, что хочется отметить: у разработчиков явный прогресс! Визуальная часть игры стала лучше, музыка, сопровождающая вас всю игру, делает своё дело - держит вас в напряжении. Ещё больше впечатлений приносит Радик, его манера общения, поступки, слова…

Всё это кажется таким знакомым… 
Образ Радика, лично для меня, ассоциируется с моим отцом, такой же страшный манипулятор, несущий только вред, прикрываясь тем, что он хотел сделать «хорошо», а ты якобы ему неблагодарен, за все те вещи которые он делает.

Главный герой (в одной из концовок), опять же, лично для меня, ассоциируется с моей матерью, которая думает, что «какая-то крыша над головой» предпочтительнее, чем попытка сделать свою жизнь хоть немного лучше, не бояться себя отстаивать и совершать свои собственные ошибки, не надеясь на подобного «Радика», который якобы сможет тебе помочь.

И это ранит, прямо в самую глубину души, от осознания, что это не просто игра, а чья-то жизнь.

Я люблю игры BOBER BROS, за то, что они поднимают такие темы в своих играх, не только для того, чтобы «напугать», а осветить РЕАЛЬНЫЕ проблемы РЕАЛЬНЫХ людей.

NO MEANS NOTHING it's a videogame with an emotional story that conveys an important message: the importance of saying ''No''. This story is based on a real experience that, unfortunately, one of the developers had to endure. A story that seeks to make you uncomfortable, to show the true psychological terror: the one we suffer in our daily lives. Sometimes,''No'' might feel meaningless but it's important to protect your peace, your boundaries, to protect yourself. This story teaches you the importance of having boundaries, the importance of saying ''No''.
If you identify with the situations shown in the story, believe me, you will spend a long time thinking about the message conveyed by this great game. I had to do things I didn't want to do in toxic relationships, I had to endure disgusting and embarrassing situations despite I said no, and thanks to this game I have been able to reflect on all of this. 
Thank you to the developer's courage in deciding to create this game, raising awareness of these situations and sending a positive message.
Support BOBER BROS and remember to learn to say ''No''.

Review of **NO MEANS "NOTHING**
**CHARACTERS & STORY :** I’m not sure whose real story inspired this game, but I truly hope that person managed to escape from their situation—just like in one of the good endings. I’ve experienced something similar myself, though not to this extreme, so I’m in no position to judge what they went through.

What I can say is that the game was absolutely epic one of the best I’ve played this year.
It also taught me something important from its inner message: learn to say no.

I’ll be editing my gameplay soon and will share it here.
And to the person whose story this is based on—thank you for sharing something so personal with us. Kudos to you. Story: 10/10

**MUSIC & GAMEPLAY :** I loved the atmosphere the game created. The concept was unique—the whole packing/unpacking mechanic felt surprisingly fresh. At first, I thought I might need to run the game on low graphics, but it turned out to be very well optimised.

The background music was amazing and really set the mood.

A couple of issues I noticed:

After the credits, the game sometimes gets stuck on the final art screen.

While picking up items for packing, my mouse occasionally got stuck. 
Overall, still a great experience.
Gameplay: 9/10

**OVERALL: 9.5/10**
